chapters.title: 01 / THE FIRST SHIFT
chapters.desc: Prove yourself on your first passenger run
chapters.intro: "First day? Relax. Just get me to the Arts District in one piece."
chapters.outro: "Smooth. I'll tell my friends about you."

chapters.title: 02 / THE DINNER RUSH
chapters.desc: A restaurant needs a reliable courier
chapters.intro: "Six ramen bowls for the dorms. Hot food, happy students — move!"
chapters.outro: The students cheer. Five stars from the whole floor.

chapters.title: 03 / THE AIRPORT PICKUP
chapters.intro: "My meeting starts in minutes. Old Town, as fast as is legal."
chapters.outro: "Made it with time to spare. Keep the change."

chapters.title: 04 / THE NIGHT SHIFT
chapters.desc: A late-night trip across the city
chapters.intro: "Emergency surgery. Hospital, please — careful but quick."
chapters.outro: "You may have just helped save a life tonight."

chapters.title: 05 / THE BIG CLIENT
chapters.desc: A premium customer needs a smooth ride
chapters.intro: "I judge people by how they drive. Impress me."
chapters.outro: "Impressive. I have a lot more work for a driver like you."
